facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 6% equity, subject to terms and diligence
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage tech startup，跨行业、全球 founder；入选后参加 Silicon Valley 的4个月 in-person Flagship program，并接受 500 Global 投资与尽调。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: Global-from-day-one 思维；已有 MVP / 初始 traction；清晰可扩张市场；能在4个月内快速迭代产品、增长和融资。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 必须按 Flagship 项目要求参加 4个月 in-person program，官方当前页面写明在 Silicon Valley / San Francisco Bay Area 举办。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 国际 founder 可申请，但参加美国线下项目需要合法赴美身份；官网当前 Flagship 页面未公开统一签证 sponsorship。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 官方申请表；团队、产品、市场、traction、融资及公司信息。入选需完成投资尽调。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 使用 Flagship application portal；500 Global 不鼓励绕过正式申请流程。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 全球化 tech startup；pre-seed/seed；已经有产品方向、希望在 Silicon Valley 强化 GTM、PMF、fundraising 和 network 的团队。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 无法在项目期到 Silicon Valley 线下参加；非科技或不可规模化业务；已明显超出早期加速阶段且不需要系统性 GTM/PMF 支持。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：全球 founder 进入 Silicon Valley 的高价值通道之一。Deal 明确，但 6% 对已有较高估值/融资的团队成本可能偏高。

facts.Foundshore Verdict: Depends on sector and stage fit.
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 6% equity, subject to terms and diligence
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage technology startups from any industry or country. Selected teams attend the four-month Silicon Valley Flagship program and complete investment due diligence with 500 Global.
facts.Strong-to-Have: A global outlook, an MVP or initial traction, a scalable market and the ability to iterate on product, growth and fundraising over four months.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Four-month in-person Flagship program in Silicon Valley or the SF Bay Area.
facts.Visa / Relocation: International founders may apply, but US attendance requires lawful entry. The current Flagship page does not publish standard visa sponsorship.
facts.Application Materials: Official form covering team, product, market, traction, funding and incorporation. Investment due diligence follows selection.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the Flagship application portal; 500 Global discourages bypassing the formal process.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Global pre-seed or seed technology teams with a product direction, seeking Silicon Valley go-to-market, product-market fit, fundraising and network support.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Teams unable to attend in Silicon Valley, non-technology or unscalable businesses, or companies beyond early-stage acceleration needs.
facts.Notes: A valuable Silicon Valley entry route for international founders. Terms are explicit, although 6% equity may be costly for companies with higher valuations or previous funding.
